description: Data-audit dashboard. Encodes measurement.md's panel-shape rule: judge a datasource by distinct dates PER SYMBOL and by its DENSE span, never by raw min(date) or a row count.

list.name: table
list.label: Table
list.definition: tables with both a date and a symbol column
list.query: SELECT c.table_name FROM information_schema.columns c JOIN information_schema.columns c2 ON c2.table_schema = 'public' AND c2.table_name = c.table_name AND c2.column_name = 'symbol' JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relname = c.table_name AND s.schemaname = 'public' WHERE c.table_schema = 'public' AND c.column_name = 'date' AND s.n_live_tup > 1000 ORDER BY 1

title: Data Freshness & Coverage

panels.title: Freshness of every dated table
panels.description: max(date) per table for every public table with a `date` column and >1000 rows, computed live via query_to_xml. Takes ~7s. 'Days stale' is only computed when the value parses as ISO — a non-ISO value in this column is itself a finding (insider_trades stores '31 Oct, 2025').

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT c.table_name, s.n_live_tup,
         (xpath('/row/m/text()', query_to_xml(
            format('select max(%I)::text as m from public.%I', c.column_name, c.table_name),
            true, true, '')))[1]::text AS max_val
  FROM information_schema.columns c
  JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relname = c.table_name AND s.schemaname = 'public'
  WHERE c.table_schema = 'public' AND c.column_name = 'date' AND s.n_live_tup > 1000
)
SELECT table_name AS "Table",
       n_live_tup AS "Rows",
       coalesce(max_val, '(empty)') AS "Latest date",
       CASE WHEN max_val ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
            THEN CURRENT_DATE - left(max_val, 10)::date END AS "Days stale"
FROM f
ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Largest tables on disk
panels.description: TimescaleDB hypertables report the parent relation at ~0 bytes because the data lives in chunks — stock_ohlcv and friends will look small here. Row counts come from the planner's estimate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT relname AS "Table",
       n_live_tup AS "Rows",
       pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS "Size",
       pg_total_relation_size(relid) AS "Bytes",
       coalesce(last_autovacuum, last_vacuum) AS "Last vacuum",
       coalesce(last_autoanalyze, last_analyze) AS "Last analyze"
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND n_live_tup > 0
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 40

panels.title: $table — per-symbol depth (NOT a row count)
panels.description: measurement.md: a table can report years of span while holding 4-5 rows per symbol. Min/median/max distinct dates PER SYMBOL is the honest measure of whether this datasource can support a backtest.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Symbols",
       min(n) AS "Min dates/symbol",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n) AS "Median dates/symbol",
       max(n) AS "Max dates/symbol"
FROM (SELECT symbol, count(DISTINCT date) AS n FROM $table GROUP BY 1) t

panels.title: $table — dense span by year
panels.description: Distinct dates per calendar year. A table can claim '5 years' while dense coverage only starts 2 years in — this is the panel that shows it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT left(date::text, 4) AS "Year",
       count(DISTINCT date) AS "Distinct dates",
       count(*) AS "Rows",
       count(DISTINCT symbol) AS "Symbols"
FROM $table
WHERE date::text ~ '^[0-9]{4}-'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CURRENT_DATE - max(left(date::text, 10)::date) AS "days stale"
FROM $table WHERE date::text ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'

panels.title: $table — update frequency (rows and symbols per date)
panels.description: Gaps here are missed runs. A collapse in 'Symbols' with 'Rows' holding up means the universe shrank, not that the job died.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d AS "time", count(*) AS "Rows", count(DISTINCT sym) AS "Symbols"
FROM (
  SELECT left(date::text, 10)::date AS d, symbol AS sym
  FROM $table WHERE date::text ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
) t
WHERE $__timeFilter(d)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: technical_signals columns 100% NULL
panels.description: A fresh table is not a delivered feature. These columns are fed to every model as a hardcoded default. Measured on the last COMPLETED day, so enrichment columns that lag the scan by one day are not counted as dead.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "all-NULL columns" FROM (
  SELECT e.k
  FROM technical_signals t, LATERAL jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t)) e(k, v)
  WHERE t.date = (SELECT max(date) FROM technical_signals
                  WHERE date < (SELECT max(date) FROM technical_signals))
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.v IS NOT NULL) = 0
) s

SELECT count(*) AS "sparse columns" FROM (
  SELECT e.k
  FROM technical_signals t, LATERAL jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t)) e(k, v)
  WHERE t.date = (SELECT max(date) FROM technical_signals
                  WHERE date < (SELECT max(date) FROM technical_signals))
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.v IS NOT NULL) / count(*) < 50
) s

panels.title: technical_signals — feature coverage, worst first
panels.description: Every column of the ML feature table with its populated %, on the last completed trading day. This is the check a per-table freshness monitor structurally cannot make.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.k AS "Column",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.v IS NOT NULL) AS "Populated rows",
       count(*) AS "Total rows",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.v IS NOT NULL) / count(*), 1) AS "Populated %"
FROM technical_signals t, LATERAL jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t)) e(k, v)
WHERE t.date = (SELECT max(date) FROM technical_signals
                WHERE date < (SELECT max(date) FROM technical_signals))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 4, 1

panels.title: Provider-id integrity — tlid that is not numeric
panels.description: data-sources.md: a provider-issued id column holding the SYMBOL instead of the provider's id is a permanent, self-concealing 404. 412 of 2,234 nse_stocks rows had exactly this. Any non-empty row here is a live gap.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'tlid (Trendlyne)' AS "Column",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE tlid IS NOT NULL AND tlid !~ '^[0-9]+$') AS "Malformed",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE tlid IS NULL) AS "Missing",
       count(*) AS "Rows"
FROM nse_stocks WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stockid (MoneyControl/MarketsMojo)',
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE stockid IS NOT NULL AND stockid !~ '^[0-9]+$'),
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE stockid IS NULL), count(*)
FROM nse_stocks WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'companyid (ET)',
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE companyid IS NOT NULL AND companyid !~ '^[0-9]+$'),
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE companyid IS NULL), count(*)
FROM nse_stocks WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'isin',
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE isin IS NOT NULL AND isin !~ '^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{10}$'),
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE isin IS NULL), count(*)
FROM nse_stocks WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
